facts.fact: The document says all National Safety Net Programme cash transfers use the Enhanced Single Registry for, among other things, secure management information systems, and that delivery systems run through the Consolidated Cash Transfer Programme MIS (CCTP-MIS).
The document says all National Safety Net Programme programmes use the Enhanced Single Registry for electronic transfers to bank accounts and mobile money.

The document says KSEIP 2 strengthens cash transfer delivery through the CCTP-MIS, and that the CCTP comprises the Older Persons, Orphans and Vulnerable Children, and Severe Disabilities cash transfers.
